patch_description:
The current program is structured as a single function that handles all planning steps. This can make the code difficult to read and maintain, especially as the complexity of the task increases. By refactoring the code into smaller, modular functions, we can improve readability and maintainability. Each function will handle a specific aspect of the planning process, such as picking up an object, walking to a destination, and placing an object. This modular approach also makes it easier to test and debug individual components of the plan.

The refactored code will maintain the same inputs and outputs as the original program, ensuring compatibility with the rest of the system. The main function, `generate_contact_plan`, will call these modular functions in sequence to build the complete contact plan.

By structuring the code in this way, we can improve the overall performance of the program, making it more robust and easier to evolve.
